question: In 1953,who among the following dancers was called to perform for the coronation festivities of Queen Elizabeth (II)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumari Kamala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kumari Kamala**, a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer, was invited to perform during the coronation festivities of **Queen Elizabeth II in 1953**.
 
• She was celebrated for her exceptional contributions to Indian classical dance, particularly in Bharatanatyam, which showcased India's rich cultural heritage on the global stage.
 
• Her performance at the coronation festivities highlighted the growing recognition and admiration of Indian classical arts in the international community.
 
• Kumari Kamala, also known as Kamala Lakshman, started her career as a child prodigy and gained fame for her dedication to preserving and promoting traditional Indian dance forms.
 
• She later moved to the United States, where she continued to teach and perform, furthering the global reach of Bharatanatyam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It combines **expressive gestures (mudras)**, rhythmic movements, and storytelling to depict themes from Hindu mythology.
 
• The dance form is deeply rooted in the Natya Shastra, an ancient Sanskrit text on performing arts.
 
• Bharatanatyam is traditionally performed by solo dancers and is known for its intricate footwork and precise expressions.
 
 
 
• **Coronation of Queen Elizabeth II**
 
 
• Queen Elizabeth II was crowned on **June 2, 1953**, at Westminster Abbey in London.
 
• The coronation was a grand event attended by dignitaries and representatives from across the world.
 
• The festivities included cultural performances from various countries, reflecting the global reach of the British Empire at the time.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Dance**
 
 
• India is home to several classical dance forms, including Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Odissi, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, and Mohiniyattam.
 
• Each dance form is unique in its style, costumes, music, and storytelling techniques.
 
• These dances are often deeply spiritual and are performed to express devotion and tell mythological tales.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Diplomacy**
 
 
• Events like Kumari Kamala's performance at the coronation highlight the role of art and culture in strengthening international relations.
 
• Cultural diplomacy promotes mutual understanding and appreciation between nations through artistic and cultural exchanges.
